title: Vertical Aerospace Just Secured a Critical Supplier Agreement for Its Valo Fleet: Time to Buy?
author: Lee Samaha
description: Vertical Aerospace signed a long-term supplier agreement with Astronics for power distribution systems for its Valo eVTOL, reducing execution risk. However, the company remains unprofitable with significant cash burn and won't generate earnings until 2032. Substantial shareholder dilution is expected as the company raises capital, with share count projected to rise from 157 million to 373 million by 2032.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the Astronics supplier deal reduces execution risk and the company has 1,500 preorders, significant headwinds remain including cash burn, no profitability until 2032, and substantial expected shareholder dilution. The deal is positive but doesn't offset fundamental financial challenges.

title: What to Know About This Fund's $59 Million Astronics Bet Amid a 170% One-Year Stock Surge
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: Pertento Partners established a new $59.07 million position in Astronics by purchasing 815,333 shares in Q1 2026. The aerospace and defense company's stock has surged 170% over the past year, driven by strong Q1 results including 12% sales growth, record bookings of $290.4 million, and an all-time high backlog of $734.3 million. The fund's investment suggests confidence that Astronics' aerospace recovery momentum still has significant room to run.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong operational momentum with 12% sales growth, nearly tripled net income, record bookings of $290.4 million, and all-time high backlog of $734.3 million. Stock has surged 170% in one year, and a major fund's new $59M investment signals confidence in continued growth potential in the aerospace recovery.

description: The aircraft lighting market is experiencing robust growth, expanding from $1.74 billion in 2025 to $1.86 billion in 2026 with a projected CAGR of 6.3% through 2030, reaching $2.38 billion. Growth is driven by rising commercial aircraft production, widespread LED adoption for energy efficiency, regulatory mandates for improved safety lighting, and innovations in smart cabin lighting and connected systems.
